title: Sydney Airport slot management reform
summary: Reforms to Sydney Airport's slot allocation and demand management, to curb slot hoarding and give new entrants access, applied from 26 October 2025.

instruments.title: Sydney Airport Demand Management Amendment Act 2024

direction_rationale: Stricter use-it-or-lose-it rules free slots that incumbents hold to block rivals, easing entry on Sydney routes.

assessment.summary: Tighter slot rules at Sydney Airport, to stop incumbents holding slots they do not use and to give new entrants access. Slot access is the main barrier to new airlines on Sydney routes; the curfew and movement cap remain.

marks.reason: Stricter use-it-or-lose-it rules free slots for new and smaller airlines.
